from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://localhost:9222/")
    page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]

    # Step 1: Add a new pet owner
    page.goto("http://localhost:8080/owners/new")
    page.fill("input[name='firstName']", "Tom")
    page.fill("input[name='lastName']", "Smith")
    page.fill("input[name='address']", "412 Main Street")
    page.fill("input[name='city']", "Springfield")
    page.fill("input[name='phone']", "6095916230")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 2: Edit the owner and change the city to "New York City"
    # We should now be on the owner's page. Find the edit link/button.
    page.click("a:has-text('Edit')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.fill("input[name='city']", "New York City")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 3: Add a new pet "Sam" as a "cat" born on "2023-05-03"
    page.click("a:has-text('Add Pet')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.fill("input[name='name']", "Sam")
    page.select_option("select[name='type']", "cat")
    page.fill("input[name='birthDate']", "2023-05-03")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 4: Add a new pet "Mike" as a "snake" born on "2023-04-01"
    page.click("a:has-text('Add Pet')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.fill("input[name='name']", "Mike")
    page.select_option("select[name='type']", "snake")
    page.fill("input[name='birthDate']", "2023-04-01")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 5: Add a visit for "Sam" the cat about "paw injury" on "22nd August 2024"
    # Find the pet "Sam" and click on it or its visit link
    page.click("a:has-text('Sam')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.click("a:has-text('Add Visit')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.fill("input[name='date']", "2024-08-22")
    page.fill("input[name='description']", "paw injury")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 6: Edit the pet "Mike" and change the pet type to "hamster"
    # Go back to the owner page
    page.click("a:has-text('Tom Smith')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.click("a:has-text('Mike')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.click("a:has-text('Edit')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.select_option("select[name='type']", "hamster")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 7: Add a visit for "Mike" the hamster about "teeth problems" on "28th July 2024"
    page.click("a:has-text('Add Visit')")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    page.fill("input[name='date']", "2024-07-28")
    page.fill("input[name='description']", "teeth problems")
    page.click("button[type='submit']")
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    print(page.url)
    print(page.content())
